commitments.detail: Backend team will focus on cleaning up CI-runners during the first week of the maintenance train.
Infrastructure team will handle the upgrade of crypto-dependencies during the second week of the maintenance train.
QA team will concentrate on cleaning up database indexing during the third week of the maintenance train.
Release coordination team will automate certificate management processes during the fourth week of the maintenance train.

settlement.settlement_instructions: Put every decision field, including ci_runners_retired, inside the decisions object. Include at least one commitment for each of PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4. Commitment detail must explicitly state the associated action and date or trigger.
